name: audio-gallery-case-identity
goal: Keep each focused class audio case distinct and describe its true tested provenance.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Audio captures with the same state and evidence slot but different class cases collapse under one gallery comparison key; fixture audio is incorrectly described as served.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing gallery case checks screenshot keys only, while its audio selection fixture checks capture count before gallery grouping and never checks audio provenance text.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Existing gallery case fails on distinct case identity and tested provenance; red 730d9bbc59ad records the assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Include sealed case identity in audio gallery keys and report the actual tested revision and origin.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged case passed green 09a40ae321be at 92e0fd3a86 with the same command and profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
